subject.title: Feature - Implement paid certificate or badge for a manual review and approval of skills

question: Should ClawHub offer a paid expedited human security-review program, and what assurance may its badge communicate?
rationale: Maintainers must decide whether payment may affect review priority and define neutral outcome rules, attestation scope, expiry, revocation, appeals, refunds, and liability before implementation.

options.title: Design narrow attestation
options.body: Define a time-bounded, revocable artifact-review attestation with explicit criteria, audit records, neutral outcomes, and payment only for queue priority.

options.title: Offer unpaid review
options.body: Add an artifact-level human-review signal without payment or expedited access.

options.title: Keep current signals
options.body: Continue using publisher identity, Official status, moderation, and automated scan signals without a certification program.

recommendation.title: Design narrow attestation
recommendation.body: Define a time-bounded, revocable artifact-review attestation with explicit criteria, audit records, neutral outcomes, and payment only for queue priority.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main trust-policy, badge, schema, and moderation history makes this the strongest available decision owner.
